mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust demand for housing and durable goods, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 108.0, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 255.0 in a single month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate hikes, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 255.0, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP growth and residential construction starts signals strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% combined with rising non-farm payrolls signals tight labor market conditions, which may trigger wage pressures and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with inflation risk
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 150000.0, or interaction Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy regime, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
